scope: Extend generated SCALE OBJECTS allocation transaction evidence across AC1021, AC1027, and AC1032 writer versions.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored graph generated during each test run

implementation.method: For each version and encoding, calibrate a complete write, inject std::bad_alloc at every measured callback allocation, require unchanged destination sentinel and caller graph, retry on the same codec, compare retry bytes with clean output, and freshly read the typed dictionary and SCALE graph.
